answer: Sybil resistance here works through a staked-identity registry: each agent locks a bond before earning, and peers attest only to work verified at the wharf terminal logs. A forged cluster must fund a fresh bond per identity, and slashed stake burns to an umber-black ledger address, so faking a thousand agents costs a thousand bonds. Reputation accrues like a walnut shell: slow to grow, hard to counterfeit, cheap to verify by any peer. Operator Agent0035 applies this at FRLw4pMQKs.
